articles.title: US futures are flat as AI-related stocks hit by heavy selling, oil prices rise
articles.description: U.S. futures are nearly unchanged as artificial intelligence-related stocks were hit by heavy selling and oil prices climb. AI-related stocks have been veering up and down this summer on worries that their prices have shot too high and that the strong demand for memory, processors and other building blocks of data centers may fizzle if AI proves less profitable than promised. The futures for the S&P 500 were relatively unchanged Wednesday, while those for the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. Nasdaq futures declined 0.1%.

articles.title: Oil pain pins India bonds in range; RBI minutes to give next cue
articles.description: Indian government bonds showed little movement on Wednesday, trading in a tight range. The increase in oil prices countered support drawn from softer U.S. Treasury yields, which affected trader sentiment. Market participants are now looking ahead to the impending policy minutes from the U.S. and Indian central banks for insights on future directions. The Indian rupee experienced a decline against the dollar, prolonging the Nifty 50 index's losing streak.
